# JD Media — Ottawa Web Design

> JD Media builds fast, conversion-first websites for local service businesses in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Specializing in HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, electrical, and home services companies.

## What We Do

JD Media is an Ottawa-based web design agency run by JD Aitken. We build mobile-first, conversion-optimized websites for local service businesses that turn website visitors into phone calls and booked appointments. We are not a large agency — we are a focused, one-person operation that acts as a "Digital Caretaker" for our clients.

## Services & Pricing (CAD)

All plans include a custom 5-page website, hosting, SSL, and ongoing support. 12-month minimum commitment.

- **Starter Plan** — $295/month: Custom 5-page website, mobile-first design, fast loading, hosting and SSL, domain managed for you, on-page SEO setup, 1 content update per month. 12-month minimum, then the custom site is yours to keep.
- **Growth Plan** — $495/month (most popular): Everything in Starter, plus a conversion-optimized layout, Google Business Profile managed monthly, monthly SEO content targeting local searches, a simple monthly performance report, up to 3 content updates/month, response within 1 business day
- **Pro Plan** — $895/month: Everything in Growth, plus Google Ads managed for you (ad spend paid directly to Google, pause anytime), a quarterly 15-minute strategy call, same-day response, and priority on everything

One-time project quotes are also available for businesses that prefer to own their site outright.

## Portfolio & Case Studies

- **Bytown Plumbing** (Ottawa, ON): Mobile-first website rebuild. Results: +40% mobile calls, 2-second load time, +25% organic traffic, 15+ new leads per month.
- **Legendary Landscaping** (Ottawa, ON): Conversion-optimized site for Ottawa landscaping company.
- **Superior HVAC** (Ottawa, ON): Mobile-first website for Ottawa HVAC contractor.
- **Capital City Cards** (Ottawa, ON): Website for Ottawa retail business.

## Process

1. **Discovery** (Week 1): Kickoff call, competitor research, keyword analysis. Deliverable: project brief and sitemap.
2. **Design** (Week 2): Wireframes and mockups, client review and revisions. Deliverable: final design files.
3. **Development** (Weeks 3–4): Clean code build, mobile optimization, SEO and tracking integration. Deliverable: staging site.
4. **Launch** (Week 5): QA, cross-device testing, deploy to production. Deliverable: live website.
5. **Ongoing Support**: Post-launch bug fixes, content updates, monthly check-ins (Pro plan).
